{{Quote|They took it upon themselves to make a ''record'' of Jedi history and teachings&hellip;|Palpatine, to Leia Organa Solo, on the actions of a group of Jedi around this year|<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''590 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. The era, having begun more than [[1000 BBY/Legends|four hundred years earlier]], featured widespread settlement into the unexplored regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the opening of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Around this year, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bodo Baas]] updated the [[Tedryn Holocron]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|teaching device]].

==Proem==
After a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of conflict between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the [[New Sith Wars]] came to an end in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] narrowly escaped destruction, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] announced the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], reorganizing the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="ATLAS">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and codifying the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a branch of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="character">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> the Jedi [[Bodo Baas]] was one of a group of Jedi who lived and served in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]] and who took it upon themselves to create records of Jedi history and teachings for future Jedi to learn from.<ref name="DE" /> After being promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]],<ref name="character" /> Baas inherited a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and teaching device, the [[Tedryn Holocron]].<ref name="force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==The galaxy in 590 BBY==
{{Quote|A brother and sister born to walk the sky,<br />But reckless brother falls--into dark side's eye!<br />Jedi sister carries hope for future in her womb.<br />Only ''she'' can save the Skywalkers from certain doom!<br />A Jedi-killer wants to tame her.<br />Now the Dark Side Lord comes to claim her.<br />She must battle join against this thief,<br />Or the dynasty of ''all'' the Jedi will come to grief!|The prophecy of Baas's Master was added to the Tedryn Holocron around 590 BBY|<ref name="DE6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>}}
The year 590 BBY was also known as 3,063 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC),<ref name="YearTC" /> a peace agreement that brought an end to the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="ATLAS" /> 590 BBY was also the same as 410 after the Ruusan Reformation,<ref name="YearRuu" /> and 555 before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (BrS), a year-notation system established in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]].<ref name="YearGrS" /> By 590 BBY, the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that followed the Ruusan Reformation, was more than four hundred years in the making.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> The Republic continued its expansion into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and uncharted [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] areas that later became part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="ATLAS" />

After completing his records around 590 BBY, Bodo Baas updated and reorganized the Tedryn Holocron,<ref name="FF" /> which had once been held by his ancestor, [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]].<ref name="force" /> Bodo Baas added to the holocron the prophecy that had been written by his [[Bodo Baas's Master|own Master]] [[990 BBY|four hundred years earlier]].<ref name="DE6" />

==Impact==
The Great Peace of the Republic continued for nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|six hundred more years]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> as the Republic continued to expand. [[Galactic economy|Economic forces]] began to shape the Republic, as companies bought [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and established the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="nec" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="force" /> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] took the Tedryn Holocron from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="DE" /> Solo fulfilled the prophecy of Baas's Master when she and her brother, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|defeated]] Palpatine.<ref name="DE6" />

==Notable events==
*Around this year, Bodo Baas put his records&mdash;including his Master's prophecy&mdash;into the Tedryn Holocron. {{Circa}}<ref name="DE" /><ref name="DE6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]], written by [[Tom Veitch]], makes only a passing reference to Bodo Baas and his group of Jedi, who collected Jedi knowledge and recorded it six hundred years prior to 10 ABY&mdash;or 590 BBY&mdash;in which the story takes place.<ref name="DE" />
